source.paper: Pisareva & Richaud -- cirDNA End-Motif Frequencies (2- and 4-mers) from sWGS; preprint 10.1101/2025.09.17.676909

format.table: one sheet per group and assay; 256 motif rows, the samples in two column blocks (counts on the left, fractions on the right) separated by an empty column, with a trailing Mean column
format.motif_order: lexicographic ACGT -- the repository's own _kmer_index order, verified against it here
format.features: <sample>.motifs.npy -- the 256 frequencies in the repository's motif order, the format the repository's own loader reads
format.library: shallow WGS, primary alignments, proper pairs, MAPQ >= 30, GRCh38; motifs at the 5' fragment boundary
format.note: The deposit states that the motifs come from the 5' boundary but does not say whether both strands' ends were counted per fragment, which is what the repository's own motif extraction does. That ambiguity is carried with every number computed from these features.
